== Notes ==
* Combines well with [[Ether Phantom]], [[Overload]], [[Phantom Pain]], [[Shrinking Armor]], [[Wastrel's Demise]], and [[Web of Disruption]].
* Be careful if you are partied with several other Mesmers.  On one hand, you have a good chance of being able to use this skill on any target, at any time. On the other hand, you may remove a well-planned hex placed by an ally who won't appreciate your undoing of their hex.
